title: AI Data Extraction and Post-Session Processing

chapters.title: AI Data Extraction and Post-Session Processing
chapters.subtitle: Learn from every chat

steps.text: A chat is more than answers. It holds names, emails and needs, and when it ends it has an outcome. This video shows the Data Processing and Metrics tab of a profile: how the assistant collects details while it chats, what it analyzes after the chat ends, and how it measures its own results.
While a chat runs, data extraction picks out details, such as a name or an email address.
When the chat ends, post-session processing analyzes the whole conversation: a summary, an outcome, and more.
Over time, metrics tell you whether chats are solved, liked, and worth the cost. All three are settings of the profile.
Open the profile, and open the Data Processing and Metrics tab. Session inactivity timeout is how long a chat can be silent before it is closed. The default is thirty minutes.
Tick Enable data extraction. The assistant now picks details out of the conversation as it goes. Extraction check interval is how often it looks: every this many messages from the user.
Click Add Entry for each detail. Enter a Name, such as customer email, and a Description that tells the assistant what to look for.
Allow Multiple Values keeps several values, such as several products. Updatable lets a later answer replace the value, for example when a customer corrects an email.
Tick Enable post-session processing, and the assistant analyzes the whole conversation after the chat closes. Closing a chat also starts the AI Chat Session Closed workflow event.
On the Tasks tab, click Add Task. Enter a Name and Instructions. The Type Semantic returns free text, such as a summary.
The type Predefined Options picks from a list, such as resolved, escalated or abandoned. Add each choice with Add Option, a Value and a Description.
The Capabilities tab next to it picks the tools that the assistant may use while it analyzes.
The metrics need the AI Chat Session Analytics feature. Enable session metrics collects the numbers for the chat reports, and adds thumbs up and thumbs down buttons to the answers.
Enable AI resolution detection lets the assistant decide whether each closed chat solved the problem of the user.
Enable conversion metrics scores each closed chat against your goals. Click Add Goal, and enter a Name, a Description of what to judge, and the Min score and Max score.
Extracted details and the results of the tasks appear in the AI reports of the site, one row for each chat.
They are also available to workflows, which can send the details to another system, or notify a person.
The analytics fields appear only after the profile is saved as a chat profile, and only when the analytics feature is on.
Collect the details you need while people chat, analyze the chat when it ends, and measure the results. Thanks for watching.
